personality_one_liner: A high-intensity, command-center sports interface blending fantasy football mechanics with a fast, betting-style operational UX.

spacing.rule: Use tight structural spacing with functional dividers. Padding inside cards should be functional (sm/md), never excessively airy. Keep thumb zones clear for primary actions.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary to build depth rather than glass, optimizing for high data density and quick legibility.
dont's: No blur-heavy sheets or transparent frosted cards.
No glass on leaderboards or bet slips to maintain maximum contrast.

screens.name: LandingGate
screens.purpose: High-impact public entry screen mixing marketing copy ('Dove Fantacalcio e Ludopatia si uniscono') with auth gate.

states.error: Standard toast or inline text error below inputs.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero stadium background image (darkened with a gradient scrim top-to-bottom). Bottom 40% holds oversized Barlow Condensed typography, marketing subtext, and segmented 'Login / Register' form in a solid surfaceSecondary card pinned to the bottom.

screens.name: DashboardHub
screens.purpose: Primary landing post-login containing minigame entry points and live round status.

states.empty: No active minigames - abstract football tactic illustration with 'Nuova Giornata in arrivo'.

screens.layout: Sticky top header with user avatar and current Serie A round. Scrollable list of Minigame cards (Undici 1v1, Indovina il Calciatore, etc.) using surfaceSecondary. Each card displays an icon, title, and a 'status' badge (e.g., 'Da Giocare', 'In Corso'). At the bottom: a floating persistent 'Bet Slip' style minimized bar showing 'My Pronostici' summary (e.g., '3/4 Selections Made') that expands via Bottom Sheet.

screens.name: MyPronostici
screens.purpose: The user's 'Bet Slip' showing selected teams/answers for the current round.

states.empty: Empty tactical board illustration - 'Non hai ancora fatto pronostici per questa giornata.'

screens.layout: Can be a standalone tab or expanded bottom sheet. High-density list. Each row represents a minigame pick. Left side: Minigame name in small caps. Right side: The selected Team/Player in brandPrimary colored text. A 'Place Picks / Confirm' sticky button at the bottom using brandPrimary.

screens.name: LeaderboardBoard
screens.layout: Horizontal segmented control at the top to filter by Minigame. Dense list layout. Rank number (Barlow Condensed), Participant Avatar (initials if no photo), Name, and Total Points. Emphasize top 3 with brandPrimary/brandTertiary subtle highlights. Elimination stamps (if applicable) overlay the avatar.

screens.name: CalendarFixtures
screens.layout: Sticky week selector header. Dense vertical list of matches. Home Team vs Away Team with team logos (if available, else names). Result badges (W/L/D) in small chips next to the score.

screens.name: AdminRequests
screens.purpose: Admin view to approve/reject user picks.
screens.layout: List of pending picks. Each card shows the user, minigame, and the pick. High-contrast action buttons: brandPrimary for 'Approve' and borderStrong outline for 'Reject'.

landing_hero.alt: A stadium filled with spectators during a night game

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility guidelines. Pure black is avoided; use #121212 and #1C1C1E to create structural depth with #27272A dividers.
BANNED: Any shade of blue (including navy, sky blue), purple, or indigo. Stick entirely to the Signal Orange (#FF5500) brand color against dark greys.
The 'My Pronostici' feature must be designed as a persistent bottom floating element (like a bet slip) over the main Dashboard, expandable via a bottom sheet.
Typography: Use Barlow Condensed for all numeric data, scores, rankings, and major headings to give a fast, athletic, betting-board feel. Use Manrope for high legibility in body text.
All cards should be sharply squared or use very minimal radius (sm: 6px). Avoid playful, rounded UI.
Ensure 'LandingGate' utilizes the stadium background with a strong top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surface opacity at bottom) so text remains readable.
No glassmorphism. This is a dense data / sports app. Rely on solid surfaceSecondary and thin 1px borders (#27272A) for separation.
